title: 5G Core UPF service failed
body:
I am setting up Open5gs Core and UERANSIM on 2 different VM machines. Upon setting up the UPF service, UPF Daemon fails with issue:
`Jan 31 15:35:36 core-5g open5gs-upfd[6379]: 01/31 15:35:36.695: [pfcp] INFO: pfcp_server() [10.128.0.15]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/path.c:30)
Jan 31 15:35:36 core-5g open5gs-upfd[6379]: 01/31 15:35:36.695: [pfcp] INFO: ogs_pfcp_connect() [127.0.0.4]:8805 (../lib/pfcp/path.c:61)
Jan 31 15:35:36 core-5g open5gs-upfd[6379]: 01/31 15:35:36.695: [sock] ERROR: socket bind(2) [10.128.0.15]:2152 failed (98:Address already in use) (../lib/core/ogs-socket.c:114)
Jan 31 15:35:36 core-5g open5gs-upfd[6379]: 01/31 15:35:36.695: [sock] ERROR: udp_server() [10.128.0.15]:2152 failed (98:Address already in use) (../lib/core/ogs-udp.c:67)
Jan 31 15:35:36 core-5g open5gs-upfd[6379]: 01/31 15:35:36.695: [app] ERROR: Failed to initialize UPF (../src/upf/app.c:28)
Jan 31 15:35:36 core-5g open5gs-upfd[6379]: 01/31 15:35:36.695: [app] FATAL: Open5GS initialization failed. Aborted (../src/main.c:219)`
I am using the internal IP address of the 5g core(10.128.0.15) which is the one signaling that is already in use. I have followed guides in an attempt to get it working however none of them work. ( https://medium.com/rahasak/5g-core-network-setup-with-open5gs-and-ueransim-cd0e77025fd7 )
I would like to know if I am possible setting up the yaml's with the incorrect addresses.
